title: escape velocity of Mars vs Earth, quick

messages.content: escape velocity mars vs earth quick!!!
Sure thing! The escape velocity for Mars is about 5 km/s, while for Earth it's around 11.2 km/s.
see? mars is easy mode!!!!! just need less boom!!!

Launching from Mars requires less energy, but there are other challenges like lower atmospheric density impacting aerobraking. It's not all 'easy mode,' but it does offer interesting engineering opportunities.
